description: Get the full text/HTML content of a single exhibit from an SEC filing, by exhibit id. Returns the exhibit text along with exhibit_type, description, company_name, accession_number, and form_type. maxLength truncates large exhibits. Exhibit ids appear as `exhibitId` in a filing's document list, as `id` in a filing's exhibit list, and as `exhibit_id` on full-text search matches.

id.description: Exhibit ID (numeric), as listed for the filing's exhibits.

maxLength.description: Truncate content to this many characters. Response includes a "truncated" boolean.

name: get_exhibit_content
title: Get Exhibit Content
